_doc: Registry for local-first dispatch. Scopes listed here get local verification before Codex. Patterns listed here always escalate unconditionally.

proposed_lanes.description: Framework verification signal review — mechanical structured output, bounded scope, low judgment requirement
proposed_lanes.rationale: verify-framework.cjs produces structured PASS/FAIL/WARN signals. Local model can review the signal output for consistency and flag obvious issues before Codex reviews the full framework state. Same pattern: local-first on structured output, escalate on uncertainty.
